pageDesc: Explore ten food and drink favourites at Hotel CAPS, from comforting soups, starters, main courses, snacks and desserts.
author: Hotel CAPS

slides.title: Variety of Soups
slides.text: Start with a comforting bowl of soup. Choose from creamy tomato, mushroom, vegetable or chicken soups, or explore favourites like sweet corn, hot and sour, Manchow, lemon coriander and East Chinese noodle soup.

slides.title: Paal Porotta Combo
slides.text: Soft, layered Paal Porotta makes a delicious companion to a choice of vegetarian or non-vegetarian curries. Pick your favourite combination and enjoy a comforting meal made for sharing.

slides.title: Paneer Roast & Mushroom Roast
slides.text: For a vegetarian favourite, choose paneer or mushroom roast. Both bring a rich, savoury character to the table and pair beautifully with a porotta or your choice of bread.

slides.title: Chicken Mughlai, Patiala & Honey Chicken
slides.text: Three chicken dishes, three different ways to enjoy them. Choose Chicken Mughlai, Chicken Patiala or Honey Chicken for a satisfying addition to your meal.

slides.title: CAPS Special Biriyani
slides.text: Fragrant rice and satisfying flavours make CAPS Special Biriyani a meal to look forward to. With vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, there’s a choice for everyone at the table.

slides.title: Chatti Choru
slides.text: Enjoy a generous combination of rice and accompaniments served in a chatti. Available in vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, it brings a variety of flavours together in one memorable meal.

slides.title: Rosemary & Masala Al Faham Mandi
slides.text: A generous serving of mandi rice meets grilled Al Faham chicken in two tempting choices: Rosemary and Masala. Bring an appetite and enjoy a meal worth sharing.

slides.title: Paal Kappa with Fish, Chicken & Beef
slides.text: Creamy Paal Kappa meets your choice of fish curry, chicken curry or beef. Each combination brings its own character to this comforting Kerala favourite.

slides.title: Porotta Shawarma: Plate & Roll
slides.text: Enjoy shawarma with the familiar appeal of Kerala porotta. Choose the plate when you want to settle in for a meal, or the roll when you’re in the mood for a handheld bite.

slides.title: Avil Milk Specials
slides.text: Finish with a refreshing Avil Milk. Choose the classic Normal, the Special with extra treats, or the Tender Coconut variety for a cool, satisfying finish.
